## Overview

This CEP documents the harmonization of hearing and vision variables from the CCHS Health Utility Index (HUI) module and Washington Group Disability Measures (WDM).

**Status**: L2 complete (semantic mapping defined)

**PR**: [#160](https://github.com/big-life-lab/cchsflow/pull/160)

## Variables in scope

### HUI hearing items (Master only)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| HUI06 | Group conversation without hearing aid |
| HUI07 | Group conversation with hearing aid |
| HUI07A | Able to hear at all |
| HUI08 | Quiet room without hearing aid |
| HUI09 | Quiet room with hearing aid |

### HUI vision items (Master only)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| HUI01 | Read newsprint without aid |
| HUI02 | Read newsprint with aid |
| HUI03 | Able to see at all |
| HUI04 | Recognize friend without aid |
| HUI05 | Recognize friend with aid |

### HUI derived (PUMF and Master)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| HUIGHER | Hearing problems (grouped) |
| HUIGVIS | Vision trouble (grouped) |
| HUIDHER | Hearing problems (derived) |
| HUIDVIS | Vision trouble (derived) |

### Washington Group (2017-2018)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| WDM_005 | Difficulty seeing |
| WDM_010 | Difficulty hearing |

## Critical findings

### 2003 Ontario exclusion

**The 2003 PUMF HUI grouped variables (HUICGHER, HUICGVIS) contain NO Ontario data.**

This is a data collection artifact, not a worksheet error. Available provinces in 2003 PUMF:

- Atlantic provinces
- Quebec

**Impact**: For Ontario dementia research, the 2003 cycle cannot be used for PUMF-based hearing/vision analysis.

### Scale change in 2017-2018

The 2017-2018 cycle uses Washington Group measures instead of HUI:

- **HUI scale**: 6-point (1-6)
- **WDM scale**: 4-point (1-4)

A 4-category harmonized scale is recommended for cross-era comparison. See [L2: Semantic mapping](L2-semantic-mapping.qmd) for the crosswalk.

## PR #160 review findings

During formal review of PR #160, several worksheet errors were identified and corrected:

1. Database name typos (`cchs_2009_2010_m` → `cchs2009_2010_m`)
2. HUI06 source variable typo (`HUAC_06` → `HUIC_06`)
3. HUI09 wrong default source variable (`[HUI_08]` → `[HUI_09]`)
4. HUI07A missing 2005 and 2007-2008 cycles
5. HUI09 missing 2011-2012 cycle

See [PR #160 notes](PR-notes.qmd) for complete details.
